manifest.name: dsh-pixel-appearance
manifest.description: Pixel, reactive, static, native, and content-guided Retrospective themes for the DSH Web GUI, with animated pixel backgrounds, pointer halos, configurable pixel geometry, canvas materials, composer and sidebar materials, and configurable two-colour main-colour gradients.
manifest.author: dsh-pixel-appearance contributors

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: appearance
      name: dsh-pixel-appearance
      config: {}

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [English](README.md)

An appearance plugin for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI**: native, pixel,
reactive, retrospective, and static themes, animated pixel backgrounds, a pointer
halo with a temporal pixel trail, configurable pixel geometry, canvas materials,
and composer/sidebar materials.

The plugin is a self-contained DSH bundle: a Host half that publishes the
Host-backed settings namespace and a browser half that renders the themes. All
pictures, palettes, and code live in this repository; there is no runtime npm
dependency.

- Seven colour combinations plus custom main/background colours.
- Pixel size (6–32 CSS px), square or rounded pixels, and a corner radius that
  scales with the pixel size.
- Two-colour main-colour gradient for the pixel field: **Universal** (one
  canvas-space angle shared by every pixel theme) or **Personal** (per
  animation, per response part, and per review sub-theme mappings), with
  Auto, Neon, Sunset, Ice, and Aurora presets, start/end colours, a strength
  slider, and an angle slider in Universal mode.
- Canvas surface material for every custom theme: frosted glass or transparent.
- Composer and sidebar materials: native, frosted glass, or transparent, each
  with colour and opacity.
- A global blur radius used by the frosted materials.
- Responsive reduced-motion behaviour.

All settings are stored in the plugin's **Host-backed Config**, shared by every
authenticated browser on the same DSH profile.

- DSH Desktop or a DSH Web GUI with the plugin manager.
- Node.js **20+** only if you want to rebuild `client.js` from source.
- The plugin is developed against DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`; the client half relies on a
  few stable conversation DOM attributes (see [Compatibility](#compatibility)).

readme.section: Recommended: install through DSH's plugin manager
readme.text:
1. Download or clone this repository to a permanent folder, for example:

```text
   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\plugins\dsh-pixel-appearance
   ```

2. In DSH, open an Agent/Creator chat and send:

```text
   Use plugin_manager with action "install_bundle" and target
   "<ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_THIS_FOLDER>", then tell me when the installation is applied.
   ```

The same operation is `plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target:
   "<ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_THIS_FOLDER>" })`.

readme.section: Recommended: install through DSH's plugin manager
readme.text:
3. **Fully quit and relaunch DSH** (do not only close the window). Host code and
   Host Config are loaded at startup.

4. Open **Settings → Appearance**. The plugin is listed as **Pixel Appearance** in
   the plugin manager, and its settings page is labeled **Appearance**.

> The bundle inserts a Host entry with id `appearance`. Disable or remove any
> other plugin that already owns that id before installing this one.

readme.section: Advanced: link the package into a profile

readme.text:
- Theme cards: Native, Pixel, Response, Retrospective, Static.
- The **Canvas style** panel is available for all custom themes (disabled under
  Native).
- The **Pixels** panel is enabled for Pixel, Response, and Retrospective themes;
  its **Gradient** block offers `off`, `universal`, and `custom` modes.
- The **Response effect**, **Composer wave**, and **Wave damping** panels appear
  when the Response theme is selected.
- The **Sub-theme animation** panel appears when Retrospective is selected.
- Static theme adds a **Static picture** panel.

| Event | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Pointer moves | Round pixel halo follows the pointer |
| Pointer click | Circular wave starts at the pointer |
| Typing / deleting in the composer | Wave from the composer edge, or a caret-centred circular wave |
| Caret movement | Same as above, using the current DOM Selection |
| New Agent message line | Wave from that row's edge |
| Halo trail | Main-colour pixels at the pointer fade over the retention time |

The trail strength maps to a retention time of **250–2000 ms**. A value of 0
disables the trail. Static and dynamic halo styles both support the trail.
Wave damping also shortens the natural wave gradient: its colour reaches the
target hue just before the damped wave fades out.

- While a session is active, the theme samples the latest rendered Chat rows
  (text, code blocks, tool calls, and questions) and scores four sub-themes.
- On a new-session screen with no Chat rows, it reads the most recent non-blank
  session read-only, scans the tail of its events, and releases it immediately.
  Failures or timeouts fall back to the session title/metadata.
- Score changes use hysteresis and a minimum interval, so a new message does not
  switch the sub-theme on every row. Empty content starts from Discussion.
- The **Sub-theme animation** panel exposes **Follow content**, **Code**,
  **Investigation**, **Creation**, and **Discussion**. Choosing a concrete
  sub-theme locks it; Follow content restores automatic selection.
- The four animations share the 8-second seamless loop and two-colour pixel
  language; they never appear in the generic Animation menu.

| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `native` | `native`, `pixel`, `response`, `review`, or `static` |
| `palette` | `auto` | `auto`, `deepsea`, `neon`, `sunset`, `forest`, `paper`, or `custom` |
| `mainColor` / `backgroundColor` | — | Custom colours for the Custom palette |
| `animation` | `ripple` | Pixel animation: `ripple`, `rain`, `aurora`, `pulse` |
| `pixelSize` | `10` | Pixel block size in CSS px (6–32) |
| `pixelStyle` | `square` | `square` or `rounded` |
| `pixelRadius` | `0.25` | Corner radius as a fraction of the pixel size (0–0.5) |
| `gradientMode` | `off` | `off`, `universal` (one canvas-space gradient), or `custom` (per-target mappings) |
| `gradientPreset` | `auto` | `auto`, `neon`, `sunset`, `ice`, `aurora`, or `custom` |
| `gradientFrom` / `gradientTo` | — | Start/end colours for the `custom` preset; empty falls back to the main colour and its derived end |
| `gradientAngle` | `135` | Universal gradient angle in degrees (0–360) |
| `gradientStrength` | `1` | Gradient blend toward the plain main colour (0–1) |
| `gradientTargets` | — | JSON map of target → `horizontal`, `vertical`, `radial`, or `off`; unset targets use `auto` |
| `resp

`client.js` is generated from the fragments in `src/`. Do not edit it by hand.

```powershell
node src/build.mjs
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

`src/INTERFACE.md` documents the fragment contract, the shared factory scope,
the pixel engine API, the Host-backed Config fields, and the runtime behaviour.

```text
dsh-pixel-appearance/
├─ index.js                 Host half: Config + settings registration
├─ client.js                Generated browser half (do not edit)
├─ cordis.patch.yml         DSH bundle patch (entry id: appearance)

- Host settings are per profile; a different DSH profile starts from defaults.
- The Response theme reads these DSH DOM attributes:
  `[data-composer-card]`, `[data-chat-flow]`, `[data-chat-anchor-key]`, and
  `[data-chat-flow-kind]`. If a DSH update changes them, update the selectors in
  `src/45-response.js`.
- The Retrospective theme reads
  `[data-conversation-content] [data-chat-anchor-key]` and
  `data-chat-flow-kind` for the current session. On a new-session screen it uses
  the DSH session list and a read-only `sessions.retain(...)` tail read of the
  most recent non-blank session, releasing it immediately. Changes to those
  selectors, session events, or the retention API need matching updates in
  `src/47-review.js`.
- Static local pictures are stored as compressed data URLs inside the profile's
  `cordis.patch.yml`; very large pictures still make the config heavy. Prefer a
  modest image or an https link.
- Remote pictures depend on the Web GUI's CSP and network access.
- On very large windows the pixel grid is capped at roughly 90,000 cells; the
  effective pixel size may be increased slightly to keep rendering smooth.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` forces the static halo,

为 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI** 提供的外观插件：原生 / 像素 / 响应 / 回顾 / 静态五种主题、动态像素背景、带时间尾迹的鼠标晕影、可调像素尺寸与圆角、画布材质，以及输入卡和侧边栏材质。

插件是一个自包含的 DSH bundle：Host 半身发布 Host-backed Config 设置，浏览器半身负责主题绘制。图片、配色和代码都在本仓库内，运行时不需要额外 npm 依赖。

- **原生**：保留 DSH 原始外观，移除所有自绘层。
- **像素**：无缝循环的像素动画，提供涟漪、像素雨、极光波、呼吸脉冲。
- **响应**：由事件驱动的像素动画：
  - 鼠标处圆形像素晕影，中心为主体色，向外过渡到背景色；
  - 鼠标点击产生圆形扩散波；
  - 输入卡输入、删除、光标移动时，从输入卡边缘或文本光标处产生波形；
  - Agent 新消息行（含流式 Markdown 块）产生行边缘波形；
  - 晕影样式可选静态 / 动态呼吸；
  - 尾迹：在鼠标位置留下主体色像素，按设置的保留时间逐渐淡出；
  - 波形阻尼：统一缩短所有波形的扩散距离并加快衰减。
- **回顾**：由会话内容指导的像素主题。进行中的会话以当前会话内容为准；新会话界面则以最近一次非空会话为准，只读扫描后立即释放。主题会从文本、代码块、工具调用和提问中判断更像「代码」「调查」「创作」还是「讨论」，并绘制对应的独有 8 秒副主题动画。副主题菜单可选择「跟随内容」自动判定，也可手动锁定四种之一。
- **静态**：在主页和侧边栏下层显示本地或网络图片，可调模糊与暗化。

- 7 组配色组合 + 自定义主体色/背景色。
- 像素尺寸 6–32 CSS px；方形 / 圆角像素；圆角半径按像素尺寸自动适配。
- 像素主体色两色渐变：**通用**（整块画布共用一个角度）或**个性化**（逐动画、逐响应部位、逐回顾副主题映射），内置自动 / 霓虹 / 日落 / 冰蓝 / 极光方案，可调起色、终色、强度，通用模式另可调角度。
- 所有自创主题共用画布材质：毛玻璃 / 透明。
- 输入卡和侧边栏材质：原生 / 毛玻璃 / 透明，可单独设置颜色与不透明度。
- 全局模糊半径。
- 适配系统「减少动态效果」。

所有设置都保存在插件的 **Host-backed Config** 中，同一 profile 的已认证浏览器共享。

- DSH Desktop 或带插件管理器的 DSH Web GUI。
- 仅在需要从源码重新生成 `client.js` 时需要 Node.js **20+**。
- 插件基于 DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` 开发；响应主题依赖少量会话 DOM 属性（见「兼容性」）。

readme.section: 推荐：通过 DSH 插件管理器安装
readme.text:
1. 下载或克隆本仓库到固定目录，例如：

```text
   C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\plugins\dsh-pixel-appearance
   ```

2. 在 DSH 的 Agent / Creator 对话中发送：

```text
   请使用 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle，target 为本机绝对路径
   "<本仓库绝对路径>"，安装完成后告诉我结果。
   ```

等价调用：`plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<本仓库绝对路径>" })`。

3. **完全退出并重新启动 DSH**（不能只关窗口）。Host 代码和 Host Config 在启动时加载。

4. 打开 **设置 → 外观**。插件管理器中显示为 **像素外观**，设置页标题为 **外观**。

> bundle 会插入 id 为 `appearance` 的 Host 条目。如果已有其他插件占用该 id，请先禁用或移除旧插件。

readme.section: 高级：手动以 link 方式安装到 profile

readme.text: 用新版本内容替换目录；如果改了源码，先重新构建，然后完全重启 DSH。只刷新页面只会更新浏览器半身；`index.js` 的 Host Config 变更必须重启。

打开 **设置 → 外观 → 主题**：

- 主题卡片：原生、像素、响应、回顾、静态。
- **画布样式**：所有自创主题可用（原生主题下禁用）。
- **像素**：像素 / 响应 / 回顾主题下可用；其中的**渐变**区块支持关闭 / 通用 / 个性化。
- **响应效果 / 输入卡波形 / 波形阻尼**：选择响应主题后出现。
- **副主题动画**：选择回顾主题后出现。
- **静态图片**：选择静态主题后出现。

| 事件 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 鼠标移动 | 圆形像素晕影跟随指针 |
| 鼠标点击 | 指针处产生圆形扩散波 |
| 输入卡输入 / 删除 | 从输入卡边缘产生波形，或光标模式从文本光标处产生 |
| 光标移动 | 同上，通过当前 DOM Selection 定位 |
| Agent 新消息行 | 从该行边缘产生波形 |
| 鼠标尾迹 | 在指针位置留下主体色像素，按保留时间淡出 |

**尾迹强度** 映射为 250–2000ms 保留时间；0 表示无尾迹。静态、动态晕影样式都支持尾迹。
波形阻尼还会缩短波形渐变的收束距离：颜色会在波形淡出之前到达目标色。

- 进行中的会话读取最新渲染的 Chat 行（文本、代码块、工具调用、问句），为四种副主题打分。
- 新会话界面没有 Chat 行时，只读地 retain 最近一条非空会话，扫描其事件尾部后立即释放；失败或超时会退回会话标题与元信息。
- 切换使用迟滞和最小间隔，避免每条新消息都切换副主题；空内容从「讨论」开始。
- **副主题动画**面板包含「跟随内容」「代码」「调查」「创作」「讨论」。选择具体副主题会锁定；选择「跟随内容」恢复自动判定。
- 四种动画共用 8 秒无缝循环和两色像素语言，不会出现在通用「动画内容」菜单中。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `native` | `native` / `pixel` / `response` / `review` / `static` |
| `palette` | `auto` | `auto` / `deepsea` / `neon` / `sunset` / `forest` / `paper` / `custom` |
| `mainColor` / `backgroundColor` | — | 自定义配色 |
| `animation` | `ripple` | `ripple` / `rain` / `aurora` / `pulse` |
| `pixelSize` | `10` | 像素尺寸（6–32 CSS px） |
| `pixelStyle` | `square` | `square` / `rounded` |
| `pixelRadius` | `0.25` | 圆角比例（像素尺寸的 0–0.5） |
| `gradientMode` | `off` | `off` / `universal`（整画布线性渐变）/ `custom`（逐目标映射） |
| `gradientPreset` | `auto` | `auto` / `neon` / `sunset` / `ice` / `aurora` / `custom` |
| `gradientFrom` / `gradientTo` | — | `custom` 方案的起色 / 终色；留空时回退到主体色及其派生终色 |
| `gradientAngle` | `135` | 通用模式渐变角度（0–360°） |
| `gradientStrength` | `1` | 渐变向纯主体色混合的程度（0–1） |
| `gradientTargets` | — | 目标到 `horizontal` / `vertical` / `radial` / `off` 的 JSON 映射；未设置的目标使用 `auto` |

`client.js` 由 `src/` 下的片段生成，不要直接编辑。

```powershell
node src/build.mjs
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

片段接口、像素引擎 API、Host-backed Config 与运行时行为见 [src/INTERFACE.md](src/INTERFACE.md)。

```text
dsh-pixel-appearance/
├─ index.js                 Host 半身：Config + settings 注册
├─ client.js                生成的浏览器半身（不要手改）
├─ cordis.patch.yml         DSH bundle patch（条目 id：appearance）

- Host 设置按 profile 保存；切换 profile 不会继承。
- 响应主题读取 `[data-composer-card]`、`[data-chat-flow]`、`[data-chat-anchor-key]`、`[data-chat-flow-kind]` 等 DSH DOM 属性；DSH 更新后若变化，需要同步调整 `src/45-response.js`。
- 回顾主题读取 `[data-conversation-content] [data-chat-anchor-key]` 与 `data-chat-flow-kind`；新会话界面使用 DSH 会话列表和只读 `sessions.retain(...)` 读取最近会话尾部后立即释放。若 DSH 更新了这些选择器、会话事件或读取接口，需要同步调整 `src/47-review.js`。
- 本地静态图片以压缩 data URL 保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中，过大的图片会让配置变重；建议使用适中的图片或 https 链接。
- 远程图片能否加载取决于 Web GUI 的 CSP 与网络。
- 超大窗口下像素格数上限约 9 万，实际像素尺寸可能被自动提高以保证流畅。
- `prefers-reduced-motion` 下强制静态晕影、暂停连续循环并停用尾迹。
- 与 `dsh-ascii-whales` 同时启用时，像素 / 响应 / 回顾主题可能叠加两层背景画布，建议只启用一个。
